claim: The unit filter uses internal codes that are not understandable and should also display the current name.
Deadlines appear in a technical format and need a readable label.
The interface does not distinguish clearly enough between missing information and data awaiting validation.
Changing language returns users to the home screen instead of preserving the open procedure.
Synonym search worked well for the Spanish terms for registration but failed for “terrace permit” versus “occupation of public space.”
The comments do not affect data integrity, but two problems are considered pilot blockers: deadline display and loss of context between languages.
